```yaml
name: OpenSSF Scorecard & SPDX License Verification

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly

jobs:
  scorecard:
    name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
        uses: ossf/scorecard-action@v2
        with:
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          output-badge: true
          badge-output-path: scorecard-badge.svg

      - name: Upload Scorecard Report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: scorecard-report
          path: scorecard.json

      - name: Commit Scorecard Badge
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add scorecard-badge.svg
          git commit -m "Add OpenSSF Scorecard badge" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push

  license-check:
    name: Verify SPDX License
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Verify license field in package.json
        run: |
          echo "Checking license field in all package.json files..."
          find . -name package.json -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            license=$(jq -r '.license' "$file")
            if [ "$license" != "MIT" ]; then
              echo "❌ $file has license: $license"
              exit 1
            else
              echo "✅ $file license is MIT"
            fi
          done
```
